note: Hosts that cost a run its window, with what they actually do. Written because this knowledge existed in data/research/ two days before a pass died on it twice: a research file nobody reads at the moment it matters is not a record, it is a souvenir. Every brief must carry this list, and scripts/passcheck.py prints it.
rule: Every fetch gets a hard timeout: curl -m 20, or timeout= on urllib. A host that hangs once goes on this list with the date. A hang is far worse than a refusal, because a refusal fails in a second and a hang burns the whole window.

hosts.note: connection refused on both 80 and 443, fails fast (172 ms) rather than hanging, so it is cheap. Held precise laser measurements for New Orleans City Park's oaks; the figures survive in search snippets and in the park's own pages.

NOT down: rate-limits hard. A burst of is_in queries without a User-Agent got HTTP 406, and after that the host refused connections for the rest of the session, taking the kumi.systems mirror with it. Send a User-Agent, keep to a query every few seconds, and treat Overpass as a scarce resource rather than a loop. Nominatim tolerated the same pace fine with a UA set.
